describe.description: The creature is a large upright chimeric animal shown in right-facing profile with both wings fully outstretched to the sides against a plain off-white background. It has the head and thick shaggy mane of a lion on top, a feathered upper chest and two broad feathered wings, and a spotted feline torso, hindquarters and long tail below. The lower body, hind legs and tail are covered in tan fur with dense dark brown rosette spots, while the neck, upper chest and wings are covered in overlapping brown, tan and cream feathers with darker tips and barring. It stands balanced on two muscular hind legs ending in large pawed feet, with no forelimbs visible, and its long tail curves down and then up to end in a dark bushy tuft. The overall coloration is warm golden-brown, tan and cream.
